protocol.training: Identical random candidate pool and full computation for both initializers. task_only minimizes parent training-query loss. self_target minimizes self-produced child's training-query loss. Child proposals see training-support only. Chosen initial artifact is the parent, not child.
protocol.budget: Same v2 four symmetric probes per update, eight meta-objective calls, unconditional adoption. Every initializer charged the complete shared training candidate evaluation budget; no extra search per arm.
protocol.evaluation: Clean-process proposals and scoring; all children frozen before holdout scoring; independent fresh holdout per generation shared across initializers and arms.
protocol.limits: Training objective ablation only, unchanged four-parameter v2 operator. External scalar oracle; no novelty, AGI or autonomous RSI claim. No outcome-based retuning or stopping.
